name: @dshtrading/client-ui-masters-quotes
description: Masters-quote language-pack plugin for the dsh-trading trading GUI: registers 中文 · 大师金句 (zh-masters, fallback zh) as a selectable language in the host Settings → General → Language row and overrides the single chat.deepDiving key — the turn-status activity line above the composer — with rotating quotes from Livermore, Buffett, Soros, Munger and other investing masters. All other keys fall through the per-key fallback chain to the host zh dictionaries, so the rest of the UI stays pixel-identical.
